content:
Anya: CI red on ubuntu-20-gpu snapshot-tests (job 49231) after merge `serialize-normalize-newlines` (commit 4f2d9e2). Failing test: prompt_layout_serializer.test — golden mismatch. logs: https://ci.redwood.local/49231 :eyes:

Marcus: ugh, can you paste the minimal diff? or attach the small snippet from the artifact? :thinking:

Anya: here's the snippet from the failing artifact:
```
- prompt: \"Hello\\nWorld\\n\"
+ prompt: \"Hello\nWorld\"
```
Seems like trailing newline normalization changed how we serialize prompts (CR/LF vs LF).

Sam: quick attempt: could be from the serializer change that strips final newline. Does the test expect a literal trailing newline in the golden? If so, we can either update golden or change serializer to preserve it. :shrug:

Anya: repro steps I'm using locally: 
```
git checkout 4f2d9e2
GIT_SHA=4f2d9e2 ./scripts/ci local-run --test tests/prompt_layout_serializer --env ubuntu-20-gpu
# or via docker
docker run --rm -v $(pwd):/app redwood/ci:latest /app/scripts/run_snapshot --target prompt_layout_serializer
```
Ran that and got same diff as CI.

Marcus: can you try a regen locally? `GOLDEN_REGEN=1 bazel test //tests/prompt:prompt_layout_serializer_test --test_output=errors` — if it matches, we update golden and add a note in the PR.

Anya: will try now. If we regenerate, do we need a changelog entry?

Rachael: yes please add a one-liner in the PR body: "golden update: serializer newline normalization" and tag @eng-ml for visibility. Also mention the composer release if we change serializer behavior.

CI-bot: rerun requested by @Marcus: queued retry for job 49231 (retry #1).

Marcus: if regen is acceptable, we should add a test that asserts explicit trailing newline handling so this doesn't silently flip. Maybe add param `preserve_trailing_newline: true|false` to the serializer test harness.

Sam: alternative is to make the serializer stable across platforms (normalize to LF) and accept new golden outputs — probably the correct fix long-term.

Anya: regen complete locally, tests passed with GOLDEN_REGEN=1. I'll open a PR with updated golden + PR description and link to this thread. PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/1234

Rachael: thanks — add a short note under "internal changelog/ops" so release folks see behavioral change.

CI-bot: rerun completed for job 49231: passed on retry (flake). Note: artifact diff still showed mismatch before regen.

Marcus: I'll follow up with a tiny unit test for trailing-newline behavior and link it in the PR. Assigning to me to add test coverage.

Anya: thanks all, will ping again if regen PR needs eyeballs. :thumbsup:
